Additive only: Plugin gates and FieldSpec keep their inline originals so all existing tests stay green; gates are byte-identical and not relaxed; main only, no push or tag or version bump; the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate is out of scope. Backfill the Core commit hash, raw acceptance output for all six commands, and a grep proof that gate-rules has zero fs and host-agent-workflows imports.
